summary: Completed testing of Admin IP Update feature for GPS Attendance blocked page. All 7 requested features verified successfully. Backend APIs (detect-network, update-company-ip, auth/login) working correctly. Frontend flow tested end-to-end: blocked page → admin button → login form → verification → update IP → page unblocks.

backend_update_company_ip.description: POST /api/tracking/update-company-ip updates the WiFi IP in work_locations settings
backend_update_company_ip.evidence: API returns {success: true, new_ip: '34.170.12.145'} and IP persisted in MongoDB

admin_login_verification.description: Admin login verification on blocked page (checks role === admin)
admin_login_verification.evidence: POST /api/auth/login returns access_token with user.role='admin' for hassan/123

network_detection_after_update.description: After IP update, /api/tracking/detect-network returns is_company_network: true

blocked_page_admin_button.description: The blocked page shows 'تحديث IP الشركة (مدير)' button

admin_login_form.description: Admin login form appears when button is clicked

update_ip_button.description: After admin verification, 'Update IP Now' button appears with current IP

full_e2e_flow.description: Full flow: blocked → admin login → update IP → network re-check → attendance page loads
